title: The merge tool refuses --lint-unknown-ok unless the owner's typed override covers it
why: The merge tool's `--lint-unknown-ok` takes any reason and names no grant. Sessions use it to pass a lane lint that read UNKNOWN. Incidents (coordinator relay, 04:55 CST Nov 16, not read by triage): the consultant used it on every lint tonight (01:01 CST); the lane artifact-pages-other-account used it on home #597 at 04:54 CST; the q_max lane's read was blocked by the classifier. Owner page item 918 (the flag for PR 2860) holds the owner's side.
note: Guard proposal from the lane artifact-pages-other-account, relayed by the coordinator 04:55 CST Nov 16: refuse the flag unless the owner's typed override covers it; and when lint reads UNKNOWN because a draft had no CI run, print "a draft without CI needs a draft CI run". It changes a guard's verdict, so it goes to the consultant's route for building (owner 14:10 CST Nov 15, relayed). It is the guard that would have stopped the lane's mistake. Search at 04:57 CST: no existing step refuses the flag; the nearest, lane-lint-unknown-on-ready-pr, fixes the UNKNOWN read and says not to lift the check to fit. A check change: test-author red case first, builder, reviewer round 1 on sonnet. Reader: the consultant.
source: coordinator 04:55 CST Nov 16, relayed by triage; undoable; not owner-typed
